title_sq: Apartament 2+1+2 ne shitje tek Bulevardi i Ri
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1+2 tek Rezidenca Globe 3X, Bulevardi i Ri, Rruga Jordan Misja.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne kati e 5 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor ne nje nga zonat me ne zhvillim te kryeqytetit.
Organizohet nga korridori shperndares i ambienteve, sonxhorno e bollshne bashke me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 1 ballkon.
Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje ndertimi te ri me punime teper cilesore dhe bashkekohore, fasade te ventiluar, kondicionim qendror etj.
Apartamenti eshte ne fazen e punimeve perfundimtare dhe behet gati per banim me Dhjetor 2025.
Disponon Garazh dhe post Parkimi me cmim ekstra.

title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale at Bulevardi i Ri
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale at Rezidenca Globe 3X, New Boulevard, Jordan Misja Street. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of a new building with an elevator in one of the most developed areas of the capital. It is organized by a distribution corridor, spacious living room with kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 1 balcony. The apartment is part of a new building with high-quality and contemporary works, ventilated facade, central air conditioning, etc. The apartment is in the stage of final works and will be ready for occupancy in December 2025.
